verdict.rationale: The Crossplane CLI supports offline testing/rendering of Compositions without a cluster (crossplane-docs-7, crossplane-docs-8), which partially covers 'validate,' but there is no evidence of an auto-format command, and crossplane-probe-2 explicitly notes there is no local plan/preview loop — every real operation requires a live cluster, unlike a typical validate→format→plan workflow. missing for 10: dedicated auto-format tooling, an actual 'plan' equivalent step, and independent confirmation of the validate/render workflow's completeness.
